chunks: Certainly, Allah has not created you aimlessly, nor left you as useless.
There is nothing between any of you and Paradise or Hell except death that must befall him.
The life that is being shortened every moment and being dismantled every hour must be regarded very short.
The hidden thing namely death which is being driven (to you) by two over new phenomena, the day and the night, is certainly quick of approach.
The traveller which is approaching with success or failure (namely death) deserves the best of provision.
So acquire such provision from this world while you are here with which you may shield yourself tomorrow (on the Day of Judgement).
ai.seo_question: How does death serve as the bridge to the afterlife according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) emphasizes that creation is purposeful, not aimless, and that death is merely the threshold between this transient world and the eternal hereafter. This passage underscores the Shia concept of *zuhd* (asceticism) not as renunciation of the world, but as using worldly resources to acquire spiritual provisions (*tazaddu*) for the inevitable return to God. The urgency is heightened by the rapid passage of time, urging believers to act before the 'hour' of death arrives.
